newsitem.title: INDIA: India extends income tax returns deadline.
newsitem.headline: India extends income tax returns deadline.

text.p: Indian tax authorities have extended the last date for submission of return of income for the assessment year 1996/97 (April-March) to November 30 in certain cases, a Finance Ministry statement said on Tuesday.
It did not specify the categories for which the date had been extended, but said the deadline had earlier been set for October 31.
The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) also extended the date for filing wealth tax returns for the same persons to November 30, the statement said.
